input.subject: Additional documents needed for supplier registration
input.body:
Dear Huda,

Thank you for your registration documents. To complete onboarding we still need two documents:
- bank_letter: missing. Please send a bank letter showing your IBAN and account holder name.
- zakat_certificate: missing. Please send a valid Zakat certificate.

Please reply to this email with copies attached.

Best regards,
Procurement Team
